thread:
support_anna: ACME reporting a post-rollout regression. Their chat completions are lowercasing env vars and some triple-backtick blocks collapse into inline code. They pasted before/after and want a rollback ASAP.
acme_dev: Repro we ran against hosted: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood/v2-chat-16k\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Example:\n```bash\necho $PATH\n```\nKEEP THIS CASE\"}]}'``` Output changed PATH -> path and sometimes turned the fenced block into `echo $PATH`.
eng_oncall_mike: Which release deployed this morning? Any tokenizer changes in the bundle?
deploybot: release/llm-serving v2.14.0 -> hosted-prod (canary 10% -> 100%) at 2026-02-15T09:12:00Z
infra_alyssa: We accidentally flipped a new tokenizer normalization flag to enabled by default: case_normalization=true. It was intended to be opt-in for cross-platform canonicalization.
priya_ml: That will collapse uppercase tokens pre-BPE which can change subword boundaries (e.g., PATH -> path, Cap+ital -> capitalize). If our chat-template fence detector relies on specific token boundaries or naive backtick tokens, it can be broken.
sre_jamie: ACME says their UI shows lowercased keys in logs; this breaks parsing on their side and is causing an escalation.
eng_oncall_mike: Need a quick token diff for the failing prompt to confirm causality. Can infra post the token arrays?
infra_alyssa: Token diff for the sample prompt below. Pre-rollout: ["Example", "\\u0120:\n", "```", "bash", "\\necho", "\\u0120$", "PATH", "\\n```", "\\nKEEP", "\\u0120THIS", "\\u0120CASE"] Post-rollout: ["example", "\\u0120:\n", "```", "bash", "\\necho", "\\u0120$", "path", "\\n```", "\\nkeep", "\\u0120this", "\\u0120case"]
infra_alyssa: Also saw BPE merges that moved backtick tokens adjacent to words, which trips a sanitizer that tries to remove stray backticks and ends up collapsing fences.
support_anna: ACME asked for ETA and workaround. They want rollback if possible.
eng_oncall_mike: Immediate plan: (1) rollback the normalization change in hosted-prod, (2) gate case_normalization behind an opt-in config per-deployment, (3) add a short-term template postprocess that re-detects and reconstructs triple-fenced blocks if fences appear stripped.
eng_oncall_mike: Internal repro script to validate canary vs prod and to produce diffs:
repro-check.sh:
#!/bin/bash
API=$1
curl -s -X POST \"$API\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood/v2-chat-16k\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Example:\n```bash\necho $PATH\n```\nDO NOT CHANGE CASE\"}]}' | jq -r '.choices[0].message.content' > out.txt
diff baseline.txt out.txt || true

infra_alyssa: Rolling back hosted-prod runtime bundle to v2.13.7 now. ETA ~8m and I'll post status updates.
deploybot: rollback started at 2026-02-15T09:31:00Z
deploybot: rollback complete at 2026-02-15T09:39:15Z
support_anna: ACME re-tested and confirms casing/fences match baseline. They asked for a written remediation plan and timeline.
priya_ml: I'll open a PR to make case_normalization an opt-in tokenizer setting in model-config, add unit tests against a customer prompt corpus (env-vars, code fences, eval seeds), and add a compatibility check in CI that runs on canary builds.
infra_alyssa: Filing postmortem note, marking SEV-2 and adding a release checklist item: \"tokenizer opt-in + run prompt-compat suite on canary\". Also adding a runtime canary flag so tokenizer variants can be tested per-tenant.
opsbot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0215-94 (SEV-2) \\u2014 owners: eng_oncall_mike, infra_alyssa, priya_ml
eng_oncall_mike: Follow-ups: merge PR, run canary compatibility job, ship opt-in flag and template-sanitizer patch. If any customer still sees diffs after rollback, paste exact before/after here and we will reopen.
support_anna: I'll draft customer communication (apology, rollback summary, mitigation plan, timeline) and coordinate legal if they escalate.
priya_ml: Also scheduling an eval job to run our top customer prompt seeds with and without case_normalization; if diffs affect fenced code blocks or tokens matching /^\\$[A-Z_]+$/ then fail the job.
eng_oncall_mike: Good work team, keep updates here. If infra needs an emergency revert window, let's keep this channel reserved for deploy notes only.
